new_cards.claim: GDT711 assigns the complete form dain one abstract lexical core Wert II, with the local grade-versus-count realization stored separately. This consolidates three active senses within the working dictionary; it does not identify a historical unit or independently prove the numeric value or a portable component meaning.

GDT711 assigns the complete form daiin one abstract lexical core Wert III. Its seven active senses are consolidated while Grad III and drei remain local contextual realizations. The shared working core does not establish that every occurrence is a quality grade, three portions, or an independently confirmed number.

GDT711 retains qodaiin as a distinct weak wholeform reading Wert III. Its decomposition remains open between qod|aiin and qo|daiin, with no free QO semantic credit; abstract value, contextual axis and internal segmentation are separate unresolved claims.

GDT711 narrows the olkar lexical core to the intersection shared by its live rivals: hot, wood and share I. Preparation versus extract (Ansatz versus Auszug) is removed from that core. This is an active working-dictionary scope choice, not independent proof of the wood identity, a product/process distinction or a free OLK/component meaning.
